result.title: Most races at the World Rally Championship (individual)
result.content: The most races at the World Rally Championship (individual) is 214, achieved by Sébastien Ogier (France) between 2008 and 2026. Sébastien Ogier overtook Jari-Matti Latvala's record of 213 WRC starts at the 2026 Rally Italia Sardegna. Ogier is a nine-time world rally champion, a joint-record with his compatriot Sébastien Loeb.
